# Register-ZbxPassiveProxyStatsProvider

## SYNOPSIS

Registers a scriptblock that answers zabbix.stats requests to a passive proxy session.

## SYNTAX

```
Register-ZbxPassiveProxyStatsProvider [-Name] <string> [-ScriptBlock] <ScriptBlock> [-PassThru] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Register-ZbxPassiveProxyStatsProvider cmdlet sets how the passive proxy session named in -Name answers a zabbix.stats request, the internal statistics a server's zabbix[stats,...] item asks a proxy for. The session keeps no counters of its own, so the scriptblock runs on the session's runspace with the request's JSON text and returns a hashtable that becomes the answer's data. It writes the session only with -PassThru.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Answer with a few statistics

```powershell
Register-ZbxPassiveProxyStatsProvider -Name 'dmz-proxy' -ScriptBlock {
    param($request)
    @{ version = '7.0.0'; started = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds() }
}
```

The hashtable's keys and values are the answer's data, as the requesting item reads them.
